title: Rescaled ball masses converge to θ ω_n R^n (fact R1 of the parent proof)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^N, let V be an n-varifold on U (V : Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, θ ∈ [0,∞] and R > 0. Suppose Θ^n(μ_V, x) exists and equals θ, i.e. HasDensity n μ_V x θ (lim_{ρ↓0} μ_V(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) = θ with closed balls). Then, with V_{x,t} := rescaledMeasure V x t = t^{-n}·(η_{x,t})_#V, η_{x,t}(z,S) = (t^{-1}(z−x), S), V_{x,t}(B_R(0) × G(N,n)) → θ·ω_n·R^n as t ↓ 0 (in ℝ≥0∞: θ * unitBallVolume n * ofReal R ^ n). No hypothesis x ∈ U, θ < ∞ or bounded first variation is needed.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞) (R : ℝ), HasDensity n V.weight x θ → 0 < R → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ rescaledMeasure V x t (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal R ^ n))
